source_snapshot.items: All E1.s NVMe LED Check - Hard drive power
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert an E1.S NVMe into a backplane slot, observe its power LED, and collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Use system LED specification; LED is solid green while the drive is powered.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; only proposes lsblk/nvme list through insecure SSH and incorrectly claims no risk, omitting insertion and visible LED proof.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; requires qualified insertion, bay/serial mapping, ESD/hot-plug controls and direct solid-green visual evidence.

old_problem: The historical review left a clear hybrid power-LED case pending for the bay population, hot-plug policy and LED oracle, while DeepSeek misclassified read-only enumeration as both the test and risk-free execution.
disposition_reason: The source directly defines the physical stimulus and visible result. ED-03/07/09/20 allow chassis/backplane revision, required bay population, drive identity, service procedure and LED stabilization as signed runtime inputs. A qualified operator performs insertion and photographs solid green; authenticated read-only NVMe inventory only correlates the correct bay/serial and health. Missing project mapping blocks execution, not review, and software enumeration is never substituted for pixels.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2214, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2215 / Wistron-HW-00490-V002 / 644b2f17198f3196 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Define `All E1.s` as the signed supported/populated bay matrix; do not force a drive into unavailable or out-of-scope bays.
Bind chassis/backplane revision, bay label, slot/port/controller and expected drive serial/model/firmware before handling hardware.
Use the vendor-approved hot-plug or powered-down insertion/removal path with ESD, orientation and latch controls; operator inserts once.
Record the exact bay LED from empty/off through powered solid-green steady state for the signed stabilization interval.
Collect authenticated complete NVMe inventory/subsystem/health to correlate bay and serial; enumeration alone cannot prove color, location or steady state.
Preserve host/BMC/SEL/AER evidence and stop on resistance, heat/odor, power fault, missing drive or abnormal LED without reseating/retry.
No physical insertion/removal, power action, NVMe query, photo, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Per-bay E1.S insertion, solid-green power LED and NVMe identity correlation
test_case.purpose: Verify every required E1.S bay powers the correctly identified NVMe and drives the specification-defined physical power indicator to solid green, with normal enumeration and no insertion, backplane or platform fault.
required_package: Chassis/backplane revision and signed meaning/population matrix for `All E1.s`
Vendor hot-plug or powered-down insertion/removal plus ESD/service procedure
Authenticated NVMe inventory/health access, stop limits and approved final hardware state
test_case.test_command: For each signed bay, the qualified operator verifies power/hot-plug policy, ESD, orientation and target identity, records the empty/off baseline, inserts the approved drive once, and captures timestamped photos/video of the exact bay LED reaching solid green for the signed stabilization interval. Read-only collectors obtain complete NVMe controller/namespace/subsystem/health and preserved host/BMC/SEL/AER events, correlating bay, serial and visual evidence. Remove or leave the drive only per the signed final-state procedure.
test_case.expected_result: Every required bay contains the approved serial/model, the device enumerates healthy through the mapped controller, and the exact bay's power indicator transitions to and remains solid green within the signed interval with no mechanical, power, NVMe, AER, BMC or platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when bay/serial identity, approved insertion, real solid-green steady-state visual evidence, enumeration/health and error limits all match for every required bay. Wrong/missing drive, absent/wrong-color/non-steady LED, mapping ambiguity, insertion/power fault or health/error anomaly is FAIL. Missing bay/hot-plug/LED oracle is BLOCKED at execution; enumeration alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact bay population/map, drive identities, hot-plug/power/ESD procedure, LED oracle and final state are signed.
Qualified operator handles hardware; never force orientation, connector or latch and power down when hot-plug is not approved.
Use authenticated read-only software access; no insecure SSH, log clearing, inferred LED state, repeated insertion/reseat or automatic retry.
Stop on resistance, arcing/odor/heat, wrong bay/drive, abnormal LED, missing device, power fault or NVMe/AER error.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash plus SUT/backplane revision and required bay matrix
Bay-slot-controller map and expected drive serial/model/firmware
Approved hot-plug/power/ESD procedure, operator identity and timestamp
Per-bay pre/insertion/post photos/video showing exact location and solid-green steady LED
Authenticated full NVMe inventory/subsystem/health correlated to bay and serial
Preserved host/BMC/SEL/AER events, final state, discrepancy/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On resistance, power/thermal anomaly, wrong identity, missing device or abnormal LED, stop immediately and preserve evidence. The operator follows the signed safe removal/power-down procedure and leaves the bay/drive in the approved state; do not reseat, retry, reset or power-cycle automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The unique Master row consistently requires physical insertion and solid-green observation. DeepSeek's enumeration-only substitution is corrected as a review mismatch, not a source conflict.

blocked.reason: The power-LED purpose and safe hybrid method are clear; bay map, service procedure and LED oracle are runtime project configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Chassis/backplane revision and required bay population; bay/controller/drive serial map; hot-plug versus powered-down ESD procedure; LED location/color/stabilization; software correlation, stop limits and final hardware state.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED HYBRID PHYSICAL/VISUAL TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND QUALIFIED OPERATOR REQUIRED; NO INSERTION/REMOVAL, POWER, QUERY, PHOTO, RETRY, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Storage/backplane hardware owner, NVMe owner and qualified ESD/service operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign the bay/drive matrix, safe handling procedure, LED oracle and final state before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: Approved ED-03/ED-07/ED-09/ED-20/ED-30 parameterization, physical-hardware, visual-evidence and no-retry rules
external_authorities.application: Keeps insertion/visual proof operator-owned, protects hardware and uses enumeration only for identity correlation.

project_authority: Backplane/storage owner signs bay/hot-plug/LED oracle; NVMe owner signs drive map/health; qualified operator supplies physical/visual evidence; end engineer owns verdict.
